Multimode graded index optical fiber also allow several light paths. The core has several concentric layers of material, almost like the circular rings of a tree. These layers cause the light path to bend in a sinusoidal pattern instead of being sharply reflected.

Multimode graded index optical fibers are easy to work with and have good information carrying capacity. They have approximately the same diameter as step index optical fibers, but their bandwidth varies with distance along the fiber.
